folded.object: hinnay

spans.text: Hebeltô numuk gita maliinuh, kay agattiina Kaa waysiisanam kee hinnay, kaadu baaxoh agattiina korsamaanih gar kaa waysiisonu ma duudan.

Kulli num qiishat caddoy dudda leeh, kaa kee kay buxah m

folded.subject: kaadu qibaada
folded.object: fardi abtol takku

spans.text: Woo garat edde tan diinik korsitaamaay,isi diini elle faxe gurral yay beleeleqqeemi, dibuk yanu, sinaama’lluk yanu, sasot abu, yayballu, barittol takku, hinnay kaadu qibaada kee fardi abtol takku.

folded.object: kay farditte

folded.object: agattinaani maaddam faxximta kinnim baxxaqissaah

folded.object: curriyatitte inkih loowitam duudah hebeltô baxsa maleh
